mission: Establish a shared theoretical framework from the Ankhural Codex that the group can use to plan their approach to the wound.
why_now: The Ankhural Codex has been recovered and the thin-place experience has divided the group. The theoretical framework must be addressed before the disagreements calcify into factional positions.
conflict: Four-way intellectual conflict — Sera (lattice necessary), Torin (lattice artificial), Kael (both projecting), Ben (listening)
turning_point: The Ankhural Codex debate ends without consensus — four incompatible interpretations of the same evidence. Ben's willingness to sit with uncertainty distinguishes him.
emotional_trajectory: Four positions, one question, no consensus. Interaction between perspectives is the key.
notes: No consensus — the debate ends without resolution. Shared framework, incompatible interpretations. Ben's willingness to sit with uncertainty established.
